Nazywam się Mateusz Zguda. Rozwijam prze: My name is Mateusz Zguda. I develop ventures, products and teams. I combine experience in sales, technology and marketing with the practical work of running my own organisations.
Od pierwszych rozmów i określenia kierun: From the first conversations and setting a direction, through bringing the right people together, to organising the work. Usually where flexibility and a mix of skills are needed.
Jako partner odpowiadam za rozwój agencj: As a partner, I’m responsible for growing the agency and building its structures. I get involved in projects that call for particular flexibility and a dynamic approach. Joanna is a partner and the agency’s president.

Założyłem i prowadzę fundację wspierając: I founded and run a foundation supporting people fleeing the war in Ukraine. We started by opening up an empty office in Kraków.
Zaczęliśmy od 22 miejsc w pustym biurze: We began with 22 places in an empty office in Kraków. Later, we rented two hostels where we accommodated 90 people in total, and were given access to flats on Lea Street.
Organizowałem miejsca schronienia, współ: I organised accommodation, partnerships and the foundation’s team. Over time, we also began building a financial base for our continuing work — that idea led to the Ciepło restaurant.

Restauracja należąca do fundacji. Ukraiń: A restaurant owned by the foundation. Ukrainian food, art and hospitality at 15 Dietla Street in Kraków. As president of the management board, I’m responsible for the business side of the venture.
Ciepło wyrosło ze wspólnego gotowania w: Ciepło grew out of cooking together at the foundation’s accommodation sites. With Olena’s considerable involvement, we opened a restaurant that combines traditional Ukrainian food with a contemporary approach, art and Carpathian culture.
Chcemy, żeby była miejscem spotkań i zap: We want it to be a meeting place and a source of financial independence for the foundation. I’m responsible for the business side of the venture; the restaurant’s day-to-day operations are in the team’s hands.
Firma technologiczna, którą w 2012 roku: A technology company I founded with Adam in 2012. I developed sales, client relationships and the organisation of project delivery.
Agencja marketingowa, którą założyłem z: A marketing agency I founded with Adam as a separate business spun out of KISS digital. I was fully responsible for sales and developing client relationships.

W 2012 roku razem z Adamem założyliśmy K: In 2012, Adam and I founded KISS digital. In 2018, we spun out Human — the second company we built together. At both companies, I was fully responsible for sales while also helping develop the organisations and client projects.
KISS digital realizowało projekty mobiln: KISS digital delivered mobile and web projects end to end in multidisciplinary teams. I led discovery, advised on products, built dedicated teams and ways of managing projects. I also took an active part in concept development and creative work.
W 2022 roku sprzedaliśmy obie firmy do T: In 2022, we sold both companies to THG (TenderHut). Before that, I worked in events, media and advertising.
Projekty realizowały zespoły KISS digita: Projects were delivered by KISS digital teams and partners. My contribution included sales and developing client relationships, discovery, consulting, organising teams and concept work.
Moja praca, poza tworzeniem ciekawych pr: Alongside creating interesting projects, my work has introduced me to a wide range of extraordinary people and places.
